question.question: When a non-Vagabond base faction crafts an item, where does that item come from and where is it placed, and what is the usual VP reward?

expected.expected_answer: Take the corresponding item from the item supply on the map and put it in the Crafted Items box on the faction board. Normally score the card's printed victory points; the Eyrie's Disdain for Trade is the already-tested exception, and Builder suppresses it. Resolve the immediate effect and discard the crafting card.

source_passages.section: Actions — Shared movement, crafting and battle (item card crafting)
source_passages.quotation: An item card requires the corresponding **item token** in the map supply, or it cannot be crafted. Take the item token into Crafted Items and score the VP printed on the card, subject to Eyrie exception.

source_passages.section: Actions — Shared movement, crafting and battle (item token destination)
source_passages.quotation: | Item token produced by an item card | Map item supply | Crafting faction’s Crafted Items box; when Vagabond itself crafts, it may immediately take its crafted item face up into Satchel/track |

source_passages.section: Actions — Eyrie Dynasties (7), Disdain for Trade
source_passages.quotation: **Disdain for Trade:** Crafted items score only **one VP instead of printed VP** (other extra crafting-point effects still apply). Builder ignores Disdain.

answer.ruling: A non-Vagabond faction takes the item token from the map item supply and places it in that faction’s Crafted Items box.
